text:
The plate is a square dinner-style plate, roughly 26 cm across. On it are about 3-4 strips of bacon, which may be overlapping, and about 8 roasted Brussels sprouts.

Bacon: cooked strips weigh about 8 g each, so 4 strips come to roughly 32 g. At about 5 kcal per gram (cooked bacon is around 4.5-5.4), that is about 150 kcal.

Brussels sprouts: 8 small sprouts weigh about 10 g each, so about 80 g. With oil roasting at about 1 kcal per gram, that is about 80 kcal.

Total: about 112 g and 230 kcal.
